literal_meaning: ঘটি (মাটির পাত্র) + রাম (নাম); একটি ব্যক্তির নাম
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা ঘটিরাম, কোনো কাজই ঠিকমতো করে না।
অফিসে এমন ঘটিরাম রাখলে কোম্পানি ধ্বংস হয়ে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a Ghatiram; he can't do any work properly.
Keeping such a Ghatiram in the office will ruin the company.
history: Originates from Dinabandhu Mitra's 19th-century Bengali play 'Sadhabar Ekadashi', where the character Ghatiram is depicted as a lazy and incompetent servant, satirizing colonial-era zamindari system inefficiencies.
note: This idiom is specifically tied to Bengali literary tradition and is not widely used in everyday speech.
